title: Claude Code Pricing 2026: Plans, Limits, and Hidden Costs | Superblocks

facts.fact: Anthropic's Pro plan costs $20/month on a monthly plan or $17/month on an annual plan, billed as $200 upfront, per the Superblocks page (pricing stated as correct as of June 2026).
facts.quote: At $20/month on a monthly plan or $17/month on an annual plan ($200 upfront), it covers a single user across all three Claude products.

facts.fact: The Free Claude plan does not include Claude Code.
facts.quote: The Free plan gives you access to Claude on web, iOS, Android, and desktop, but **does not include Claude Code**.

facts.fact: Anthropic's Max 5x plan costs $100/month and provides 5x Pro capacity per five-hour session.
facts.quote: **Max 5x ($100/month):** 5x Pro capacity per five-hour session.

facts.fact: Anthropic's Max 20x plan costs $200/month and provides 20x Pro capacity per five-hour session.
facts.quote: **Max 20x ($200/month):** 20x Pro capacity per five-hour session.

facts.fact: Anthropic's Team Standard seat costs $25/seat/month on a monthly plan or $20/seat/month on an annual plan.
facts.quote: $25/seat/month on a monthly plan or $20/seat/month on an annual plan.

facts.fact: Anthropic's Team Premium seat costs $125/seat/month on a monthly plan or $100/seat/month on an annual plan.
facts.quote: $125/seat/month on a monthly plan or $100/seat/month on an annual plan.

facts.fact: Claude Code is not included on Team Standard seats; only Team Premium seats bundle Claude Code.
facts.quote: **Claude Code is not included on Standard seats** (Premium only).

facts.fact: Anthropic's Team plan requires a minimum of 5 members and allows a maximum of 150 seats.
facts.quote: It requires a minimum of 5 members and tops out at 150 seats.

facts.fact: Organizations with more than 150 seats must upgrade to Anthropic's Enterprise plan, according to the Superblocks page.
facts.quote: Organizations with more than 150 seats need to upgrade to Enterprise.

facts.fact: Anthropic's Enterprise plan pricing starts at $20/seat, with usage billed separately at API rates.
facts.quote: Pricing starts at $20/seat with usage billed at API rates.

facts.fact: Claude Code usage counts against the same five-hour session and weekly limits as Claude chat usage on a subscription.
facts.quote: your Claude Code usage **counts against the same limits as your Claude chat usage**.

facts.fact: Usage limits on Anthropic's Pro plan reset weekly and across five-hour sessions.
facts.quote: Usage limits reset weekly and across **five-hour sessions**, with the exact token count Anthropic permits varying by model selection.

facts.fact: The Superblocks page states that $200/month equals roughly $6.67/day.
facts.quote: The math: $200/month is roughly **$6.67/day**, which beats the API rate for sustained Opus usage.

facts.fact: Team plans allow purchasing usage credits so members can keep working after reaching their seat's included limits.
facts.quote: Team plans also support purchasing usage credits that let members continue working after hitting their seat's included limits.

facts.fact: Premium Team seats provide 5x more usage per session than Standard Team seats.
facts.quote: 5x more usage per session than Standard seats.

facts.fact: Fable 5 access on consumer plans is in promotional mode prior to June 12, 2026, per the Superblocks page.
facts.quote: Fable 5 access ships in [promotional mode](https://support.claude.com/en/articles/15424964-claude-fable-models-on-your-plan) on consumer plans (prior to June 12, 2026).

facts.fact: The Superblocks article was published on 2026-06-19.
facts.quote: Published Time: 2026-06-19

facts.fact: Anthropic's Enterprise plan includes HIPAA-ready offerings for healthcare deployments.
facts.quote: [**HIPAA-ready offering**](https://support.claude.com/en/articles/13296973-hipaa-ready-enterprise-plans)**:**available for healthcare deployments.

facts.quote: | Opus 4.8 | $5/MTok | $25/MTok | $6.25/MTok | $0.50/MTok |

facts.fact: Anthropic's listed API price for Sonnet 4.6 is $3 per million input tokens (MTok).
facts.quote: | Sonnet 4.6 | $3/MTok | $15/MTok | $3.75/MTok | $0.30/MTok |

facts.fact: Anthropic's listed API price for Haiku 4.5 is $1 per million input tokens (MTok).
facts.quote: | Haiku 4.5 | $1/MTok | $5/MTok | $1.25/MTok | $0.10/MTok |
